newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FESTA SET TO SIGN FOR MIDDLESBROUGH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FESTA SET TO SIGN FOR MIDDLESBROUGH.

text.p: Inter Milan defender Gianluca Festa has arrived in England to complete a 2.7 million pounds ($4.51 million) move to premier league Middlesbrough.
Festa, 27, was due to have a medical on Tuesday, train on Wednesday and make his league debut for bottom-of-the-table Middlesbrough against Sheffield Wednesday on Saturday.
However, another Italian, Napoli defender Mirko Taccola, has gone back home without completing a two-week trial at Middlesbrough.
